integrity: Reproducible complete finite simplicial-Morse and signed Lefschetz checks, with independent direct simplicial boundary ranks over three prime fields; independent external mathematical validation has not been performed.
limitations: One fixed ten-vertex four-regular antiprism; no infinite-family extrapolation, integral symmetry-lattice classification or equivariant sphere splitting.
title: Six two-spheres and a nonzero full-symmetry invariant for the pentagonal-antiprism perfect-matching complex
